A '''battle''' took place in the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] [[The Graveyard|Graveyard]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Following the [[Mission 46/N|discovery]] of the ruins of the [[Royal Palace of Alderaan/Legends|Aldera Royal Palace]] on an [[Asteroid 7785|asteroid]] of the Graveyard, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] spread misinformation that [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] has been found alive within the ruins of the palace as a [[Operation Yavin Kill Two|plot]] to capture the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]]. However, a group of Rebel operatives explored the ruins of the palace before the arrival of the Heroes of Yavin and foiled the Imperial trap. Moreover, the Rebels discovered the [[Alderaanian War Frigate]] ''[[Another Chance]]'', an [[armory ship]] carrying all the armaments of Alderaan. In the meantime, a fleet of [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] blockaded the Graveyard and ambushed the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] transporting the Heroes of Yavin as soon as it arrived in the system. Eventually, the sudden intervention of the ''Another Chance'' allowed the Rebels to break the blockade and escape the Imperial trap.<ref name="GoA" />
